__broaden__.αὐτῇ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’for herself’ · also plain anaphoric pronoun referring to a thing, dat. sg. with ἐν: ’in it’ (ἐν αὐτῇ, of the ship) · also reinforcing a 1st-person pronoun: ’myself’ (ἐμοί περ αὐτῇ, μοι αὐτῇ ’for me myself’) · also reinforcing a 2nd-person pronoun: ’you yourself’ (σοὶ ὧδ’ αὐτῇ ’for you yourself’) · also dat. sg. of a thing, no ἐν, ’against it’ or ’against her’, with ποτικέκλιται (referent uncertain: pillar or queen) · also plain pronoun, dat. sg. with μίσγεται: ’with her’ (οὐδέ τις αὐτῇ μίσγεται ’nor does anyone consort with her’) · also plain pronoun, dat. sg. after ἅμα: ’with her’ (ἅμα δ’ ἀμφίπολοι φέρον αὐτῇ, of Circe)

__broaden__.αὐτὰς: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., fem. acc. pl.: ’the (ships) themselves’ · also plain anaphoric pronoun after a preposition, fem. acc. pl.: ’them’ (προτὶ δ’ αὐτὰς, of the rocks)
__broaden__.βάλεν: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, in tmesis with ἀμφί: ’threw about’ · also in tmesis with ἐπί (βάλεν δ’ ἐπὶ ... ἑκάστῳ = ἐπέβαλε): ’threw over, cast upon’ · also in tmesis with παρά (πάρ … βάλεν = παρέβαλε): ’threw beside, set before’ · also without tmesis, with κε, unreal past: ’would have hurled’ (κε … βάλεν … ποτὶ πέτρας ’would have dashed her against the rocks’)
__broaden__.βουλεύειν: βουλεύω — take counsel, plan, deliberate; pres. inf. act.; βουλὰς βουλεύειν ’to give counsel’ · also inf. used as an imperative: ’take counsel’ (θυμῷ βουλεύειν ’decide in your own mind’)
__broaden__.γίγνεται: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen, arise; pres. 3 sg. (χρεὼ γίγνεται ’a need arises’) · also copular, ’is, comes to be’ (φωνὴ … γίγνεται ’the voice is’)
__broaden__.δεινὸν: δεινός — dread, terrible, awesome; masc. acc. sg. (δεινὸν χόλον ’dread anger’) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (κῦμα): ’dread’; can also be taken adverbially · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’terribly’ (δεινὸν λελακυῖα ’yelping terribly’)
__broaden__.εἶεν: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 pl., in an indirect question: ’(who) they might be’ · also with κε, potential: ’would be’ (κ’ … εἶεν) · also in a concessive condition after εἰ: ’were’ (οὐδ’ εἴ οἱ χεῖρες … εἶεν ’not even if he had hands’)
__broaden__.κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κε … ἀκούσῃς) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κε λίσσηαι ’but if you beg’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καὶ νύ κε … βάλεν ’and she would have hurled’)

__broaden__.κοίλοιο: κοῖλος — hollow; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου) · also neut. gen. sg., agreeing with σπείους: ’of the hollow cave’
__broaden__.κοῖλον: κοῖλος — hollow; masc. acc. sg. (κοῖλον λόχον ’the hollow ambush’, i.e. inside the wooden horse) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’hollow’ (κοῖλον σπέος)
__broaden__.λῦσαί: λύω — loose, release, let go; aor. inf. act., used as an imperative: ’release!, let go!’ · also complementary inf. after κελεύω: ’to release’ (ἑτάρους λῦσαί τε κελεύῃς ’bid your companions release you’)

__broaden__.νοστήσαντι: νοστέω — come home, return; aor. part. masc. dat. sg.: ’to you having come home’ · also ’(to him) who has come home’ (τῷ … οἴκαδε νοστήσαντι, of the man who has heard the Sirens)

__broaden__.φίλος: φίλος — dear, dear one; masc. nom. sg. used as voc.: ’friend’ · also plain attributive adjective, not vocative: ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also predicate adjective: ’dear’ (φίλος ἦεν Ἰήσων ’Jason was dear (to her)’)
__broaden__.φίλων: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. gen. pl. (φίλοι ’kin, dear ones’) · also attributive with ἑταίρων: ’dear (companions)’ (φίλων … ἑταίρων)
__broaden__.ἀμφ: ἀμφί (elided ἀμφ’) — around, about, concerning; + dat. · also + acc., ’around, with, accompanying’ (ἀμφ’ Ὀδυσῆα ’with, around Odysseus’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ἀμφ’ Ἄρεος φιλότητος ’about the love of Ares’) · also with ὀστεόφιν, ’around’ (ἀμφ’ ὀστεόφιν θὶς ’a heap around the bones’)
__broaden__.ἐκάη: καίω — burn; aor. pass. 3 sg., augmented (unaugmented κάη), in tmesis with κατά (κατὰ … ἐκάη = κατεκάη): ’was burned up, were burned up’ · also without preverb: ’burned’ (νεκρός τ’ ἐκάη ’the corpse burned’)
__broaden__.ἔνθεν: ἔνθεν — from there, thence; adv. of place, with suffix -θεν · also ’on the one side’ (ἔνθεν μὲν γὰρ πέτραι ’on one side are rocks’)
__broaden__.ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also article-like with an adjective and a name: ’the’ (ὁ θρασὺς Ὀδυσσεύς ’bold Odysseus’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’) · also distributive, masc. nom. sg.: ’the one’ (ὁ μὲν οὐρανὸν εὐρὺν ἱκάνει ’the one reaches the broad heaven’)
__broaden__.ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’) · also with the optative, iterative in past time: ’whenever’ (ὅτε μέλλοι ’whenever he was about to’) · also with the pres. indic., ’whereas, when’ (ὅτε τ’ ἄλλοι ἅπαξ θνῄσκουσ’ ἄνθρωποι ’whereas other men die only once’)
__broaden__.ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also ὥς ’just as’, in ὥς περ (accented before enclitic περ) (ὥς περ ὑπέστης ’just as you promised’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic με (ὥς με κελεύεις ’as you bid me’) · also postpositive after its noun, comparative ’like’ (οἰωνῶν ὥς ’like birds’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τοι (ὥς τοι ἐγὼν ἐρέω ’as I shall tell you’)
